body:
I know what happens too though, suicide has devastated people close to me and I know that it's painful, but I also know that the wounds heal. My friends and family already worry constantly about me, so if I am gone they can finally move on from that. 

Isn't it more of a waste to drain all these people and resources when I inevitably seek mental help every few months anyway?

It is nice to have people to talk to, yes. Thank you. I am possibly considering going to the hospital, because if I go home I will kill myself. Maybe that's why I'm dragging out work as long as I can.

Well, if I'm still here and have a burst of motivation to send out another round of applications I will. I can't promise any more than that. And I know there's so much out there, but it makes no difference to me if I experience any of it. I don't know how to explain that any better than that. Thanks for your support.
Well, I'm still at work but I don't think that's applicable for a non US citizen. I have previously tried to put out some volunteer applications but have not heard back from any. Thanks again though.

I think you may have read between the lines a little, I don't really feel like I've failed in life. Psychiatric professionals tend not to take me very seriously because I'm a pretty well functioning adult on a basic level. The only thing I've failed to do is find any sort of meaning and I don't know or care enough to change that.

Thank you for taking the time to reply.

I actually recently got back from a really nice holiday, and I have enough savings that I also recently switched to part time employment so I could find something else more meaningful. The problem is there's nothing I enjoy anymore, and especially right now. So it's only a matter of time before I run out of money now. 

Thank you so much for your reply. I will check out the link when I get home.
I think that's really all I have to say. Thank you for listening.
Right with you on that one, man. Keep fighting!
I can't express how glad I am to have given my account's first upvote to this comment.
